comparison.objective: Candidate adjusts gripper travel; this record removes a cordless-drill battery and places it in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate counterholds a screw during jam-nut tightening; the record simultaneously squeezes two release buttons while stabilizing the drill and sliding the pack along rails.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks angle retention after locking; the record checks remembered dual-button release, pack separation, tray placement, drill displacement, release, and stillness.
comparison.reason: Simultaneous latch release and sliding extraction test a different bimanual mechanism and endpoint.
